segments.sn12.40:1.2: “yañca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.40:1.4: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti.
segments.sn12.40:1.7: Cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
segments.sn12.40:2.1: “No ce, bhikkhave, ceteti no ce pakappeti atha ce anuseti, ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.40:2.3: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti.
segments.sn12.40:2.6: Cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
segments.sn12.40:3.1: “Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, no ceva ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti, ārammaṇametaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.40:3.2: Ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
segments.sn12.40:3.3: Tadappatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nati na hoti.
segments.sn12.40:3.6: Cutūpapāte asati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.

lines: Sā hi piyarūpesu rūpādīsu namanaṭṭhena “natī”ti vuccati.
Āgati gati hotīti āgatimhi gati hoti, āgate paccupaṭṭhite kamme vā kammanimitte vā gahinimitte vā paṭisandhivasena viññāṇassa gati hoti.
Cutūpapātoti evaṃ viññāṇassa āgate paṭisandhivisaye gatiyā sati ito cavanasaṅkhātā cuti, tatthūpapattisaṅkhāto upapātoti ayaṃ cutūpapāto nāma hoti.
Evaṃ imasmiṃ sutte natiyā ca āgatigatiyā ca antare ekova sandhi kathitoti.
Āgatimhi gatīti paccupaṭṭhānavasena abhimukhaṃ gati pavatti etasmāti āgati, kammādinimittaṃ.
Tasmiṃ paṭisandhiviññāṇassa gati pavatti nibbatti hoti.
